title: Re: Strike at Storeroom 7A
description: Re: Strike at Storeroom 7A — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Wally Wanka

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Destroy 12 Candy Fabricators in Storeroom 7A and return to Wally Wanka in The Embercore Portal.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Wally Wanka

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Destroy 12 Candy Fabricators in Storeroom 7A and return to Wally Wanka in The Embercore Portal.

Offer:

If you have some spare time I need you to let those stinking Abba Labbas know that we mean business! It seems like they just won't learn when to quit and they have started restoring the Candy Fabricators in Storeroom 7A. If it is a showdown of stubbornness they want then I'm going to send in my thickest headed, lowest brain activity having, monosyllabic muttering champion; you!

Go to Storeroom 7A and completely crush those Candy Fabricators before they get back up to full operational capacity. We have finally started to dent Abaddon's candy output, so now isn't the time to fold. Return to me, Wally Wanka, here in The Embercore Portal when you have completed this quest.

Turn-in:

You have done well, Dungeon Runner. I've never seen someone destroy things so naturally. Let me know if you want to try this quest again.

Objectives:

  • Candy Fabricators

Level range: 48–100
